topic.title: Inbox
topic.shortdesc: Every task the agents have worked on, newest first, with today's spend and counts at the top.

image.alt: The Inbox on a phone: the Today card with spend and counts, then a list of tasks.

body.p: Each row is one task: its business, status, the first line of what came in, the role that has it, the kind of work and how long ago. Choose a row to open the task.
Task statuses are queued, running, awaiting approval, deferred (held by a daily budget), done and failed.
Nothing yet? Ask for something in Chat.

The card at the top shows what has been spent today against the budget, how many tasks are done or failed, how many actions ran by themselves, and how many are to approve (choose it to go to Approvals). Below that is one line per business.
When tasks were deferred by a budget, the card says so: they run after midnight, or choose retry one now to list them and run one.
Filter by status shows only tasks with one status. Choosing a role on the Org page opens the Inbox on that role's tasks; the subtitle says Showing …, and show all clears it.
